title: System-Disc (KD02)
overview:
System-Disc (KD02) is a utility disc made for Sega Saturn game developers, not a game. Running it unlocks the console so that it will boot development discs written to ordinary CD-R media until the power is switched off.

The KD02 disc covers games from third-party publishers, while its companion KD01 disc covers Sega's own titles. It does not remove region locking.
